messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT PAGE | high embedding latency seen in eu-west; p50 spikes to 1.2s, p99 > 5s. Pager routed to eng-oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood/status/INC-2026-0421
alex c: looking
marta r: I'm on the page, tailing logs now, KV cache miss rate jumped 20% around 10:12 UTC
alex c: rolling a config change to reduce batching window to 5ms to avoid amplification — doing canary to 2 nodes
marta r: +1. Can we route traffic to standby region while we validate?
alex c: creating routing rule now: 
```bash
# temporary: route embeddings to eu-central fallback
redwoodctl router update --from eu-west --to eu-central --weight 0.5 --reason "embed latency mitigation"
```
priya s: nice, watching. If fallback looks stable we should keep for 30m and then manual rollback
sre-bot: Deploy succeeded to canary; healthchecks passing
marta r: after 6m p99 back under 800ms on canary, standby region steady. I'm going to scale down batcher threads on the problematic pool, suspected KV GC
alex c: done. Kicking a soft restart on affected pods, monitoring
james l: customer-impact: small percentage of requests had >3s latency, but no 5xx. Support ticket count up x3 but not widespread. Tagging high-severity customer if they hit spike.
alex c: paging complete, switching to mitigation channel. Assigning handoff to post-incident: we need a postmortem, action items and sizing.
priya s: Proposed action items:
  - Investigate KV eviction pattern and root cause (owner: marta r) — size: 4 (several days)
  - Add automatic region-fallback policy for embed spikes (owner: alex c) — size: 3 (a week)
  - Add telemetry: per-model prefix miss-rate dashboards (owner: james l) — size: 2 (3 business days)
  - Run load simulation to validate new batching defaults (owner: performance team) — size: 3 (1 sprint)
marta r: agree with sizing but split KV investigation into infra vs runtime: infra (2) runtime (2)
alex c: creating GH issue for postmortem + action list: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incidents/issues/478
alex c: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC, invites sent to eng, oncall, perf, product
priya s: severity classification: SEV2 (latency spike with limited customer impact) — recommend this maps to Q2 backlog for the routing fallback and KV mitigation as high priority
james l: adding rollout guard in Console to prevent aggressive batching changes during peak — size 2
sre-bot: Created recurring remediation tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-478
marta r: for quarterly planning: propose we move routing-fallback to Q2 sprint 1, KV infra fixes to Q2 sprint 2 unless blocker
alex c: noted. I'll add acceptance criteria to the issue and tag owners + DoR
priya s: action owners, please add estimated story points to the tracker by EOD. We'll do a sizing review in tomorrow's postmortem meeting and finalize quarter ties
james l: FYI I captured logs and a recording of the mitigation steps here: https://redwood.screens/rec/2165432199
marta r: closing loop: will post follow-up notes and a draft postmortem before the meeting
alex c: thanks all. If anything new pops up ping me directly. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 set to "mitigated" and awaiting postmortem. Remediation actions added to tracking board.
